description.en: A semantic package over the GLEIF Level 1 and Level 2 golden copy, published as two Parquet objects in the public semvia-pkg bucket. Ships a small legal-entity ontology, an anonymous svdb:BlobConnection descriptor that needs no credential, and three RML TriplesMaps that expose lei_records.parquet and relationship_records.parquet as a virtual RDF graph — the package carries no data, and every read is answered from the bucket by HTTP range requests.
